system: You rate how much a passage of an article matters to a reader who wants its essentials. Answer with one digit: 0, 1, 2 or 3.
intro:
A reader wants the essentials of the Wikipedia article "{title}". Below are the lead of the article and then one passage of it. Rate how much a reader who wants the essentials of "{title}" needs this passage, on this scale:
3 = essential: the reader would miss something central to the topic without it
2 = important: a main fact, event or idea of the topic
1 = detail: side information that only a reader who wants more than the essentials would need
0 = trivia: not needed by a reader who wants the essentials

Lead of the article:
{lead}
